name: MakerBot Replicator 5th Gen 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
; makerbot_tool_type=[smart_extruder_type]
; generated_by=Orca Slicer
; --- MAKERBOT BIRDWING START (MakerBot Replicator 5th Gen) ---
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0
G90 ; absolute coordinates
G1 X209 Y7.5 Z5 F9000 ; move to prime start (front)
G1 Z0.24 F600 ; lower to prime-line height
M83 ; relative extrusion for prime line
G1 E5 F200 ; set anchor
G1 X43 Y7.5 E18 F1000 ; prime line across the front
G1 E-0.5 F1500 ; short retract
G1 Z2 F600 ; lift nozzle
G1 X126 Y99.5 F9000 ; move to center
G1 Z[first_layer_height] F600 ; to first layer height
G1 E0.5 F1200 ; Unretract
machine_end_gcode:
; ===== MB BIRDWING END (MakerBot Replicator 5th Gen) =====
M400 ; wait for all moves to finish
G92 E0 ; reset E
G1 E-5.0 F2400 ; retract (snaps the filament string)
G1 Z{max(95, max_layer_z)} F180 ; lower bed; capped so firmware +50mm stays under the Z axis limit
M104 S0 T0 ; heater off
M141 S0 ; chamber off
M107 ; fan off
M73 P100 ; progress 100%
; firmware presents the plate itself (XY-park + relative +50mm Z), then shutdown
; ===== END =====
